relevant.instructions: Is this paper relevant to the stated agentic-AI research agenda? Answer true only when the paper materially studies at least one agenda area, not merely because it mentions AI or LLMs.

empirical_evidence.instructions: Does the paper report empirical evidence (experiments, measurements, case studies, or systematic observations) rather than only a proposal, position, or opinion?

topic.instructions: Choose the single best-covered agenda topic, or other/none if no listed agenda topic is materially covered.

criteria.agent_reliability: Agent reliability, robustness, failure, recovery, or trustworthiness.
criteria.evals_assurance: Evaluation, measurement, validation, assurance, or monitoring of agents.
criteria.harness_runtime: Agent harnesses, runtime, orchestration, execution, memory, or lifecycle infrastructure.
criteria.mcp_governance: MCP, authorization, governance, safety controls, or policy enforcement.
criteria.tool_use: Agent tool use, tool calling, or external side effects.
criteria.long_running_workflows: Long-running, multi-step, persistent, or asynchronous agent workflows.
criteria.other: Agentic-AI relevance outside the listed categories.
criteria.none: No material relevance to the agenda.

worth_escalating.instructions: Should this paper be escalated to expensive full insight synthesis for this agenda, considering relevance, evidence, novelty, and likely value?

implementation_relevance.instructions: Score likely implementation relevance to an agentic-AI systems team from 0 (none) to 4 (direct, concrete implementation implications).
criteria: 2 — useful context or a transferable method
4 — directly implementable system, control, or workflow guidance
